harmattanlauncher.description:
A lightweight Android launcher inspired by the philosophy of MeeGo Harmattan.
1.App drawer as main home page
2.Left, Right swipes introduces Recent drawer and widget drawer.
3.Settings Tab include custom icons, fonts, background image,dark background, meego animations.
(Note: For recent drawer view you have to manually give "Usage Acess" permission to harmattan by going into your specific device settings.)
Recommendation : Use meeyo, meeye, Nokiapure font. Ttf for the exact harmattan like view. 
Enjoy, let the legacy of meego live :).
